title: AI代理计算与安全硬件同步突破：AWS、Google、Azure与Cloudflare的云原生结构性升级概览
core_insight: AI代理计算与安全硬件的同步突破正驱动公有云向安全、可监管的AI原生架构转型。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出ECS Gateway和Lambda Web Functions，Google发布Agent Compute Engine与GKE Inference Gateway，Azure与Cloudflare发布面向AI代理的云原生基础设施及后量子密钥管理，标志着AI原生计算的重大突破。 AWS引入Continuum、Well-Architected Agent、Bedrock Managed Agents以及兼容Iceberg的S3 Tables；Google推出Confidential G4 GPU、BigQuery ObjectRef与Knowledge Catalog；Azure开放Integrated HSM并持续投入Maia 300芯片，整体提升安全与数据治理能力。 AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services AWS Weekly Roundup: Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI Announcing AWS Well-Architected Agent, an AI-powered intelligence to optimize your cloud environment (preview) Inside Agent Compute Engine: Building the compute foundation for the agentic era
